question: Who among the following promoted, raised funds for and ran the Swadeshi Steam Navigation Company (SSNCo) from Tuticorin, a coastal town in southern Tamil Nadu, to take on the might of the British India Steam Navigation Company?
solution:
The correct answer is __**VO Chidambaram Pillai**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **VO Chidambaram Pillai**, also known as "Kappalottiya Tamizhan," was a prominent freedom fighter and businessman from Tamil Nadu who established the Swadeshi Steam Navigation Company (SSNCo).
 
• SSNCo was founded in 1906 as part of the Swadeshi movement to challenge the dominance of the British India Steam Navigation Company in coastal trade.
 
• VO Chidambaram Pillai raised funds from local investors and promoted indigenous enterprise to support India's independence and economic self-sufficiency.
 
• The company operated steamships between Tuticorin and Colombo, providing an affordable alternative to British shipping services.
 
• Due to his nationalist activities, VO Chidambaram Pillai faced severe persecution by the British and was imprisoned, enduring harsh conditions for his resistance to colonial rule.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Swadeshi Movement:** A nationalist movement in India aimed at promoting indigenous industries and boycotting British goods during the struggle for independence.
 
• **Swadeshi Steam Navigation Company:** Founded by VO Chidambaram Pillai, this company symbolized India's resistance to British economic domination and encouraged self-reliance.
 
• **Tuticorin:** A coastal town in Tamil Nadu that served as a hub for trade and was strategically chosen as the base for SSNCo operations.
 
• **Impact:** Although SSNCo was eventually shut down due to British suppression, it inspired other Indian entrepreneurs and strengthened the Swadeshi movement.
 
• **Legacy:** VO Chidambaram Pillai's efforts are remembered as a significant contribution to India's freedom struggle, and he is celebrated as a symbol of economic independence and patriotism.
